verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Dropbox exposes a versioned API: its official Python and JavaScript SDKs are described as targeting 'API V2'. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-lifecycle guarantees. missing for 10: documented deprecation policy, versioning/changelog documentation, sunset or migration timelines, independent corroboration of version stability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
